This is a thought-provoking list of predictions for 2020, conveniently grouped into categories (advertising, new revenue models, consolidation, international opportunities, etc.). Contributors include many big platform, content, and media players. Hat tip to Courtney W. Holt ([@mootron)](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/n4umex4xq5uvhvqer9ao/qnc8h7h2757r0l/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9tb290cm9u) for sharing this on Twitter. 2020 is going to be a very exciting year for podcasts...

bullets.title: The Francis Mallmann episode of Chef’s Table (Season 1, Episode 3)
bullets.note: ](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/n4umex4xq5uvhvqer9ao/96szhnh3qmqpl8/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g_dj1xUThIdG00akFHYw==). This was recommended to me at least a dozen times before I finally watched it, and I shouldn’t have waited. Francis ([@francismallmann](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/n4umex4xq5uvhvqer9ao/ngaohvh58p83kd/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaW5zdGFncmFtLmNvbS9mcmFuY2lzbWFsbG1hbm4v)) is the Argentine author of one of my all-time favorite cookbooks, [Seven Fires](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/n4umex4xq5uvhvqer9ao/wob2hghv5p5wo9/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9TZXZlbi1GaXJlcy1HcmlsbGluZy1BcmdlbnRpbmUtV2F5L2RwLzE1Nzk2NTM1NDUv), and this series was created by [David Gelb](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/n4umex4xq5uvhvqer9ao/0nhwh9hwo5od7o/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9UaGlzSXNEYXZpZEdlbGI=), who also directed [Jiro Dreams of Sushi](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/n4umex4xq5uvhvqer9ao/vgu3hrh3x7xpkv/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9ncC92aWRlby9kZXRhaWwvQjAwOE9EWk5MRy9yZWY9bXN4X3duX2F2). This short episode is GORGEOUSLY shot, every bit equal to a feature film. I suggest watching with [a bottle of red wine](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/n4umex4xq5uvhvqer9ao/m3i7h5h0gpg8n9/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaW5zdGFncmFtLmNvbS9wL0JTYzFza1psWHdRLz90YWtlbi1ieT10aW1mZXJyaXNz).

bullets.title: Over 210,000 Coloradans Sign On for Wolf Reintroduction, Adding Initiative to 2020 Ballot
bullets.note: Remember my podcast episode with Mike Phillips in August, entitled “[How to Save a Species](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/n4umex4xq5uvhvqer9ao/o6tkhqhlkvkr87/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDE5LzA4LzIxL21pa2UtcGhpbGxpcHMvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9Y29udmVydGtpdCZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWNvbnZlcnRraXQmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTViZg==)”? You all helped make the above a reality! As expressed in the linked article, “This is the first time that reintroduction of an endangered species has been initiated through a direct vote of the people.” Furthermore, this reintroduction represents perhaps the only clear opportunity in the world to reestablish a major carnivore at a continental scale—in this case, from the Arctic to Mexico. Iconic biologist Dr. L. D. Mech sums up the significance nicely: “Re-establishing wolves in western Colorado could connect the entire North American wolf population from Minnesota, Wisconsin and Michigan through Canada and Alaska, down the Rocky Mountains into Mexico. It would be difficult to overestimate the biological and conservation value of this achievement.” Kudos to you all. There’s more to come, but this is the crucial first step. Please give yourselves a big pat on the back.
